answer: Concrete case: last epoch a jury of five shared one operator, so its three passes counted as one. Fix: a diversity rule caps jurors at two per funding cluster, checked before scoring, and seats hang on a trellis of independent roots rather than one trunk. A seat expires if the juror does no fresh work that epoch, and the vault of unspent seats reopens to the rotating pool. Result: a nebula of small graders, none able to carry a friend's answer alone.
